test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'MISSION' is written as ‘N64O’ and ‘TEASE’ is written as ‘U56F’. How will 'NASTY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ece5c02624dd704898427de3f28184c0e2ce1bac2a746e5a8bad09d10fd22922.png] 

The Logic applied here is:

Logic: First and last letters are moved one letter

forward and rest all letters of given word's opposite positional values are added 

MISSION → N64O 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3b717f56f4dc9365ee666d9d91c273fd7e6b4c9fc7343680a45b55c9a66f331.png] 

TEASE → U56F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ccdb39dadfbd2ff572c8a4352f90cb1ffac017ac039065af7cc2fb51e29c902.png] 

Similarly,

NASTY → O41Z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ad90cb203592693983f54963e7df36661f803d4a1179313fb747cac2d7418a.png] 

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 4"**
